svg.text: Vantage - an on-device vehicle assistant that reads every bus, answers in plain language, and says WHY
Runs inside the car: no cloud, 2 GB, 2 ARM cores. The same build scales from the in-car board to a vehicle HPC. Every number below was measured; none is typed in.
9 bus families, recognised with no per-car setup;
each decoder checked against an independent
Sealed test, 74 planted faults: right cause 87.8 % first,
Recorded events: 322 / 322 traced to the planted cause.
Raspberry Pi 4, real kernel: 22 / 22 escape attempts refused;
0 missed deadlines of a 100 Hz safety loop in 10 stress scenarios,
worst wake-up delay 390 us against a 1000 us deadline.
One build, 2 cores / 2 GB up to 6 worker processes:
5.23 -> 12.82 answers/s; 16 cars into one hub at 1977 records/s;
the autoscaler adds workers and sheds load to hold 2 s.
checked against: cantools on 77 real-car DBCs
A new car needs no code: Vantage fingerprints
the wires, maps signals it is sure of and refuses
the rest (831 reviewed signals, 76 DBCs, 0 wrong).
own cores, real-time priority, own memory;
they never wait for the assistant
100 Hz loop, 200 us work, 1 ms deadline
AI DOMAIN - a hardened sandbox the vehicle's functions cannot be hurt by
systemd unit: cgroup v2 cpuset, cpu, memory, pids; seccomp;
PrivateNetwork, read-only file system - 22 / 22 attempts refused on the Pi
one reader per wire, bounded queues
validated against what the car records
numbers from data, never from the model
The model only reads the question;
every figure comes from the stored data.

WHY ENGINE - explains causes, with evidence and honesty
Q: "why has my coolant flow dropped over the last six weeks?"
Most likely cause: cooling pump or coolant circuit degradation since about 16 Jul (confidence 94 %).
Why: The pack's coolant flow has fallen well below what it was, so the pack and the motor shed less
coolant flow fell from 10.3 to 3.1 L/min (70 % lower)
To confirm: Read the coolant pump's commanded duty against measured flow; inspect the pump, the
coolant level and the lines for air or a blockage.
real output on cooling_pump_0 (dev set; pump planted to degrade from 16 Jul)
Measured on histories with the cause planted and never read by the assistant
sealed test: 74 scenarios - first guess right 87.8 %, in top 3 95.9 %, invented cause 0.0 %;
recorded events (resets, bursts, dips, speed conflicts): 322 / 322 traced to the real cause.
AUTO-SCALING - one build, any machine: the plan is computed from the hardware, then corrected by measurement
